founders.title: Founder's Story
founders.intro: Studio Marketing Italia started with two people from completely different corners of the world — and one shared conviction: the businesses that win aren't the ones grinding the hardest. They're the ones with organized systems doing the heavy lifting.

people.name: Sarang Adalja
people.bio: Sarang Adalja grew up in India and went on to earn his Master's in Fintech from Duke University in the United States. He's the one who thinks in go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and customer experience — the engine that turns good technology into real revenue.

people.name: Giorgia Mannaioli
people.bio: Giorgia Mannaioli is from Italy, with a PhD in Linguistics from Università Roma Tre. She leads on people, client success, and branding — making sure that behind every system we build, there's a relationship our clients can actually rely on.

founders.closing: One technical and commercial, one deeply human. Together, that mix is exactly how we help businesses grow — without losing the human part along the way.

items.label: Vision
items.body: Our vision is simple: a world where business owners get to spend their time on what actually matters — their strategy, their people, their growth — while smart systems quietly handle everything else.

items.label: Mission
items.body: Our mission is to build those systems. AI-assisted tools that run and grow companies — bringing in customers, organizing the chaos, building real authority — so our clients can win their market without burning themselves, or their teams, into the ground.

team.title: Team
team.body: Behind every system we implement is a senior, hands-on team of 30+ people around the world — engineers, strategists, designers, and marketers who build it, run it, and stick around long after launch. The AI does the work. Our people make sure it actually works for you.

body: Studio Marketing Italia is a digital marketing agency that also builds software. We started by running campaigns — then realized the biggest wins came from building the pages, apps, and automations behind them.
Today we work with dental practices, restaurants, and engineering firms to grow demand and automate the repetitive work that slows their teams down.
